{{about|the mathematical concept|the British state-owned venue management company|NEC Group}}
In [[mathematics]], a '''non-Euclidean crystallographic group''', '''NEC group''' or '''N.E.C. group''' is a [[discrete group]] of [[isometries]] of the [[Hyperbolic geometry|hyperbolic]] plane. These [[symmetry group]]s correspond to the [[wallpaper group]]s in [[euclidean geometry]]. A NEC group which contains only [[Orientability|orientation-preserving]] elements is called a [[Fuchsian group]], and any non-Fuchsian NEC group has an index 2 Fuchsian subgroup of orientation-preserving elements.

The hyperbolic [[triangle group]]s are notable NEC groups. Others are listed in [[Orbifold_notation#Hyperbolic_plane|Orbifold notation]].
